attchmntText: Centrum Capital Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Centrum Capital Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results, both Consolidated and Standalone, for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The meeting commenced at 02:45 P.M. and concluded at 03:41 P.M. The results include a limited review report from Statutory Auditors Sharp and Tannan. The auditor issued an unmodified review conclusion, stating nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The financial results are available on the BSE, NSE, and company websites.
